title: Elanor
summary: The world of the Seven Kingdoms.

title: Valmyre
summary: The Lunar Empire and home of the Crescent City.

title: Thuren’derin
summary: A vast island hidden in the clouds, where an advanced scientific society observes the world below. Its leaders seek to ascend beyond the machines they created and become gods.

title: Empire of the Crystal Dragons
summary: A desert empire of crystal dragons. Its castles rise from the sand in gems that match their dragons, from jade, sapphire, and diamond to amber and amethyst.

title: Kingdom of the Red Star
summary: An empire in eternal darkness beneath the Red Star.

title: Kingdom of Awakened Creatures
summary: The animals and monsters of this kingdom absorbed magical residue and essence from humanoids, gaining sentience and the ability to use magic. Their king is a Tyrannosaurus rex with robotic arms and a wizard hat topped by a small crown.

title: Keepers of Old Secrets
summary: A kingdom that guards knowledge from ancient times, including secrets no human needs to know.

title: Valsburg
summary: The capital of Valmyre, known as the Crescent City.

title: Mines of Valciel
summary: An underground expedition site in Valciel.
